 Print Navya Naveli Nanda recently shared photographs from her Diwali celebrations, offering social media users a glimpse of the Bachchan family's festive gathering. The pictures featured Shweta Bachchan Nanda, Abhishek Bachchan , Agastya Nanda and Aaradhya Bachchan . Navya shared the pictures on Instagram with the caption, “Happiest of Diwali with my very own❤️✨". One photograph showed Agastya Nanda embracing Aaradhya Bachchan, while another captured Abhishek Bachchan and Shweta Bachchan Nanda celebrating with sparklers. The family members appeared in traditional outfits as they marked the festival together. Watch Navya Naveli Nanda gets candid about the privilege of coming from the Bachchan family; says 'I don’t think I would be where I am if...' Navya Naveli Nanda wore a red ethnic ensemble for the occasion. Agastya Nanda and Aaradhya Bachchan opted for cream-coloured outfits, while Abhishek Bachchan and Shweta Bachchan Nanda chose traditional attire in neutral shades. The photographs captured different moments from the celebrations, bringing together several members of the Bachchan family. The 'King' actor Suhana Khan commented with heart emojis. Ananya Panday commented, "You are my light." Shanaya Kapoor wrote, "My navlo." One fan commented, "I like to see the whole family together, God bless the Bachchan family." Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan arrive together at Diwali party
 Meanwhile, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan were recently spotted together at fashion designer Manish Malhotra's Diwali party in Mumbai on November 5. The couple arrived hand-in-hand and posed for photographers. Their appearance attracted considerable attention, particularly against the backdrop of recurring separation rumours. Abhishek Bachchan wore a black kurta set for the celebration, while Aishwarya Rai Bachchan looked elegant in a red chiffon saree. At one point, Abhishek Bachchan appeared visibly shy as he looked at his wife during their photographs. The couple continued holding hands throughout their interaction with the paparazzi. On the professional front, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan have not shared screen space in a feature film since 'Raavan'. Directed by Mani Ratnam, the 2010 movie featured both actors in prominent roles.
